title: Rockstar-hunted GTA 6 leaker seemingly strikes again, showing off series' most plentiful helping of onscreen johnson since San Andreas starred Carl
summary: The GTA 6 leaker Rockstar are already on the hunt for appears to have returned with new footage of protagonist Jason running around nude.

Home News Grand Theft Auto VI Rockstar-hunted GTA 6 leaker seemingly strikes again, showing off series' most plentiful helping of onscreen johnson since San Andreas starred Carl Unless it's a phallus representation of Rockstar's crime sim Image credit: Rockstar Games News by Mark Warren Senior Staff Writer Published on Oct. 8, 2026, 3:17 p.m. 2 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI The GTA 6 leaker or leakers that previously shared enough alleged gameplay to prompt Rockstar Games and Take-Two to begin the legal process of hunting them down appear to have returned, with a new 25 minute clip of them up to various hijinks in the game. A fair chunk of those hijinks have been gotten up to while protagonist Jason's in the buff, his bare bum and wiggling weenie out for all of Leonida to gawk at. Yep, that's the point we're at with alleged GTA 6 leaks. Showing off the penis physics. Assuming this isn't a build that's been messed with specially to allow full nudity - a tank spawns out of thin air at another point in the footage, so the leaker may well be using some sort of dev menu or other means of modifying the action beyond vanilla norms - big Jase's wang can be allowed out to breathe some fresh everglade air. One can only hope the intense work done on Red Dead Redemption 2 's temperature-sensitive horse bollocks has saved GTA 6's devs some time in rendering this human wood. As you may recall, GTA 5 's protagonists had pants glued to them at all times, but recently unearthed age rating descriptions have suggested 6 has a bit more flesh on display as part of its focus on depicting lovebirds, so the option to rock out with your cock out doesn't seem beyond the realm of possibility. No longer would it be a thrill saved only for random NPC cultists like GTA 5's altruists. Beyond that, the footage shows off some dirt racing around the Thrillbilly Mud Club, an off-road festival-looking event previously shown off in official trailers. There's a tease of some Lucia top-half nudity at the end, though she is still wearing a thong. Following that is something far less sexy than Jason's meat and two veg. Cyberleek, the person or group claiming to be behind the leak, ramble on in riddle-esque text about some "project" they need "expensive hardware" for. As you might have guessed they still look to be trying to use the leaks to weasel money out of people. In a statement issued amid the initial barrage of leaks laid claim to by Cyberleek, Rockstar said having gameplay come out like this had been "heartbreaking" for the devs working on GTA 6. "While it is unfortunate that the intended game experience may now be impacted by some spoilers, we hope that everyone will wait a bit longer to experience the game for themselves on November 19th," they wrote. Well, not everyone lads. There's still no news of a PC port .
